digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline - Ubuntu runner job occupancy
propositions: Ubuntu Verify jobs occupy 30.2 runner-minutes (1,812 runner-seconds) per run across three Python cells; this occupancy must be reduced without losing behavioral coverage or adding parallel resources.

The bridge-cadence test (tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_push_policy.py:164-184) calls _bridge_schedule() 1,440 times inside a comprehension, re-parsing the workflow YAML 1,440 times; hoisting the parse to run once eliminates 342.22s (5.70 runner-minutes) while preserving all exhaustive minute checks.

Pandoc corpus rendering (test_wiki_render_corpus.py and test_wiki_render_hardening.py) invokes real Pandoc 3,421 times per run with a hardening oracle that redundantly duplicates legacy conversions; replacing the legacy subprocess side with immutable committed expected outputs preserves all 884 live product conversions and current ADR 0095 while eliminating subprocess startup overhead.

AST provenance fixture setup (46-55 seconds per Ubuntu cell) repeatedly rediscovers enclosing callers and parent relationships via ast.walk iterations; caching caller/parent indices once per process preserves all 24 assertion tuples and guards while recovering setup time.

The complexity-lock static policy (tests/policies/ OS/Python-invariant check) runs identically in all four matrix cells (52-55s each); moving to the lint job and deleting matrix duplicates eliminates ~154 runner-seconds per run without changing coverage.

editor-loopback fixture setup (socket.getfqdn call, 35+ seconds) is the remaining individual >30s phase on Ubuntu; this blocks further bulk occupancy reduction and requires targeted instrumentation/remediation.
